The '''Ten Seals Covenant''' {{Lang|zh=禁锁十契}} is an organization founded by [[Suoming]] to combat the Evil Miasma in her hometown of Huating.<ref name="Simulacrum of the Heart" />

Suoming is the only surviving member of the Ten Seals Covenant. By using her Resonance Ability, she sealed the frequencies of her nine subordinates within her Vermillion Lock.<ref name="Simulacrum of the Heart" />

==History==
The organization was formed after the calamity, Evil Miasma, brought disaster and suffering to [[Huating]]. Once Suoming's childhood ended, she gathered nine others who lost their homes and created the Ten Seals Covenant.<ref name="Simulacrum of the Heart">[[Simulacrum of the Heart]]</ref>
